id: \bIt's a good thing a Nurse Joy is in here to help.
en: \bIt's a good thing a Nurse Joy is in here to help.
it: \bMeno male che qui dentro c'è un'Infermiera Joy ad aiutarci.

id: \bIt's good to do a good cave adventure sometimes.
en: \bIt's good to do a good cave adventure sometimes.
it: \bOgni tanto ci vuole proprio una bella avventura in grotta.

id: \bThis place is home to a lot of static electricity.
en: \bThis place is home to a lot of static electricity.
it: \bQuesto posto è pieno di elettricità statica.

id: \bThe Galvantula feed off of the electricity here.
en: \bThe Galvantula feed off of the electricity here.
it: \bI Galvantula si nutrono dell'elettricità di questo posto.

id: \bDon't get any hopes up. You're a long way from the exit.
en: \bDon't get any hopes up. You're a long way from the exit.
it: \bNon farti illusioni. Sei ancora lontano dall'uscita.

id: \rNurse Joy: You look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
en: \rNurse Joy: You look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
it: \rInfermiera Joy: Sembri stanco. Perché non ti riposi un po'?

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \rIris: Can you believe the size of this cave? I didn't even find any Dragon types.
en: \rIris: Can you believe the size of this cave? I didn't even find any Dragon types.
it: \rIris: Ci credi a quanto è grande questa grotta? Non ho trovato nemmeno un tipo Drago.

id: \rMight as well do some light training with you.
en: \rMight as well do some light training with you.
it: \rTanto vale fare un allenamento leggero con te.

id: \rIris: I'm gonna beat you one day. You're just a little kid after all.
en: \rIris: I'm gonna beat you one day. You're just a little kid after all.
it: \rIris: Un giorno ti batterò. In fondo sei solo un ragazzino.
